''Les Sangs et Or'' (The Blood and Golds) | short name = RAF | founded = {{Start date and age|1929}} | stadium = [[Stade Paul-Lignon]] | capacity = 5,955 | owner = Pierre-Olivier Murat | chrtitle = President | chairman = Pierre-Olivier Murat | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Didier Santini]] | league = {{French football updater|Rodez}} | season = {{French football updater|Rodez2}} | position = {{French football updater|Rodez3}} | current = 2026–27 Rodez AF season | website = {{URL|https://rodezaveyronfootball.com}} | pattern_la1 = _rodez2526h | pattern_b1 = _rodez2526h | pattern_ra1 = _rodez2526h | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = DD0000 | body1 = DD0000 | rightarm1 = DD0000 | shorts1 = DD0000 | socks1 = DD0000 | pattern_la2 = _rodez2526a | pattern_b2 = _rodez2526a | pattern_ra2 = _rodez2526a | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFC90E | body2 = FFC90E | rightarm2 = FFC90E | shorts2 = FFC90E | socks2 = FFC90E | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''Rodez Aveyron Football''' ({{Langx|oc|Rodés Avairon}}) is a French [[association football]] club based in [[Rodez]]. The club was founded in 1929 and currently plays in [[Ligue 2]], the second level of [[Football in France|French football]]. The club plays its home matches at the Stade Paul Lignon located within the city. The [[Rodez AF (women)|women's squad]] was founded in 1993 and are known as the ''Rafettes''.{{cite news |title=Rafettes maintenues |url=http://www.ladepeche.fr/article/2012/05/07/1347163-rafettes-maintenues.html |work=La Depeche |date=5 July 2012 |access-date=19 August 2012 |language=fr |archive-date=21 September 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170921095738/http://www.ladepeche.fr/article/2012/05/07/1347163-rafettes-maintenues.html |url-status=live }} They play in the [[Division 1 Féminine]], the top division in France. From 1988–1993, Rodez played in Ligue 2, and on 11 April 2019 secured promotion back to this level after 26 years in the lower divisions.{{cite web|url=http://www.foot-national.com/foot-26-ans-plus-tard-rodez-est-en-ligue-2-116850.html|title=26 ans plus tard, Rodez est en Ligue 2|publisher=foot-national.com|language=fr|date=11 April 2019|access-date=12 April 2019|archive-date=12 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190412081038/http://www.foot-national.com/foot-26-ans-plus-tard-rodez-est-en-ligue-2-116850.html|url-status=live}} [[File:Rodez AF League Performance.png|thumb|Historical league performance chart of Rodez AF]]"}}
